name: carfinder
description: Every new car, motorcycle, boat and aircraft on sale in 11 countries: list price, what dealers really charge, and the on-road price for your state, with every tax rule cited, every price sourced and a measured data-quality scorecard. Free, open source, one page.

paragraphs: Every new car, motorcycle, boat and aircraft on sale, and what it really costs. The list price, what dealers actually charge for that model right now, and the drive-off (ride-away, on-the-water, delivered) price for your state or city once taxes and fees are added, for 2,729 cars and trucks, 1,444 motorcycles and scooters, 556 boats and jet skis and 971 planes, business jets, helicopters and eVTOLs across the USA, India, China, the UK, Australia, Mexico, Spain, Thailand, Russia, Brazil and Canada, most with a photo.
